checklist_title: O&I Confined Space – Life Saving Action

checklist.question: Proof of Training for CSE Duties (e.g. HH Stickers)
Does the crew have a valid confined space permit?
Reliable communication is available for an Emergency (e.g. Hole Watch)
CSE Attendant monitoring entrant status and can communicate with entrants
Access/egress entry ways clear of obstructions?
Controls to prevent unauthorized access (e.g. Barricades, attendant, signs) are in place?
Fire extinguisher located near entry point?
Does the crew maintain an access/egress record?

expectations.question: Has the job been stopped in the event of an imminent hazard?
